name: The Crossing
description: It is a Great Lakes-type passenger and cargo ship built by Manitowoc Shipyard in the United States. It was launched in 1920 and has a load capacity of 2050t. During World War II, it was used as a short-distance transport supply ship for the US military. In July 1948, it was converted into a passenger ship by Shanghai China United Company. Late at night on January 27, 1949, due to overloading and night navigation without navigation lights, the Taiping ship sailing from Shanghai to Keelung, Taiwan sank in the waters near Baijieshan Island, Shengsi. It was China's largest maritime disaster. Only 40 people survived, and it can be called China's Titanic incident. The movie "The Wheel" was adapted from this story.
